title: Multi-Account Scaling Activation Playbook ($30M→$200M ceiling, +$XM/yr lift phased)
mandate: feedback_profit_max_priority axis #5 — Multi-account scaling capacity expansion playbook

executive_summary.key_finding: Multi-account on SAME venue provides ZERO capacity benefit and violates HL/Bybit ToS (for CEX). HL is a non-KYC DEX — multiple wallets are technically unrestricted, but share the same order book (same slippage). The correct expansion path is multi-WALLET multi-VENUE: separate EOA wallets on permissionless DEXes + Bybit sub-accounts for CEX.
executive_summary.k431_correction: K431 incorrectly flagged HL as NOT PERMITTED using CEX logic. HL is non-KYC DEX. Multiple wallets are technically OK. Real constraint = market impact (same OB).

family_member_accounts.legality: Different natural person with own KYC = separate legal entity. Fully legal.
family_member_accounts.not_ok: Operating under another person's account = likely ToS violation
family_member_accounts.tax_separation: Family member account = their profits/losses. No commingling.

do_not_do: Do NOT open duplicate personal Bybit/OKX accounts (ToS violation — account freeze risk)
Do NOT expect HL multi-wallet to reduce slippage (same order book, zero OI benefit)
Do NOT store private keys in git, HTML reports, or env files committed to repo
Do NOT force Phase 2+ before K449+K457 paper-trade gates pass (K461 condition)
Do NOT exceed 65% HL combined concentration (measure CROSS-WALLET W1+W2)
Do NOT commingle family member account funds without proper documentation
